Vendor Runtime Components

The pPreProc Windows package contains unmodified runtime libraries from
Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bruker Daltonics, and SCIEX. These files are not
licensed under the pPreProc Application License or the public repository's
BSD 3-Clause License.

They are included only as inseparable runtime dependencies for reading data
that a user is authorized to access. They may not be extracted, reused, or
redistributed as stand-alone SDKs or libraries. Product names and trademarks
belong to their respective owners and do not imply endorsement.

Thermo Fisher Scientific RawFileReader
  https://github.com/thermofisherlsms/RawFileReader
  https://github.com/thermofisherlsms/RawFileReader/blob/main/License.doc

Bruker timsdata SDK runtime
  Copyright (C) Bruker Daltonics GmbH & Co. KG.
  Use remains subject to the Bruker terms under which the SDK was supplied.

SCIEX Clearcore runtime
  Copyright AB SCIEX.
  Use remains subject to the SCIEX terms under which the runtime was supplied.

Contact chihao@ict.ac.cn before any redistribution outside the unmodified
pPreProc application package.
